DEVIATION REPORT AND CAPA
Moderna, Inc. | Quality Assurance

Deviation Number: DEV-2729-65
Title: Equipment Calibration Overdue
Date Identified: 14 April 2026
Identified By: Courtney Parker
Department: Logistics
Severity: Critical
Batch Affected: BN-22506-545
1. Description of Deviation
During routine QC testing operations on 22 January 2026, the following deviation was identified: Equipment Calibration Overdue. The event was first observed by Chad Crane and immediately escalated to the QA team. Immediate containment actions were initiated to prevent any potential impact on product quality.
2. Immediate Containment Actions
Product batch placed on hold pending investigation
Affected area quarantined and access restricted
QA notification and escalation to management completed
Samples retained for additional testing
3. Root Cause Analysis
3.1 Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
Category
Potential Cause










Man
Operator did not follow updated procedure version
Method
Procedure lacked sufficient clarity on critical step
Machine
Instrument alert threshold not calibrated correctly
Material
Raw material supplier change not reflected in procedure
Environment
Ambient conditions outside expected range
3.2 Root Cause Conclusion
The root cause was determined to be a procedural gap in SOP QA-5425-88 that did not adequately specify the critical parameter range. This allowed the condition leading to equipment calibration overdue to occur without triggering an immediate alert.

5. Effectiveness Check
Effectiveness Check Date: 16 October 2026
Method: Review of monitoring data and process KPIs over 30-day period post-implementation
Criteria for Effectiveness: Zero recurrence of same deviation type within 90 days
6. Impact Assessment
Product Impact: None — batch placed on hold pending additional testing
Patient Safety Impact: None identified at this time
Regulatory Reporting Required: No
